goal: Generate a set of 4 campaign banners in a unified style for hardware, with an overall 1:1 frame, divided into 2×2 sections with white seams.

brand.name: Apple · Vision Series
brand.logo_position: Each grid has a small apple symbol at the top left + a line of small text 'Vision Pro 2' (unofficial, for visual rehearsal only)

panels.headline: Multi-window collaboration, aligning at a glance
panels.visual: Silhouette of a user wearing a headset, multiple semi-transparent windows floating in mid-air, and a ghostly pointer shaped like an Apple Pencil

panels.headline: Place the mixing console in the air of the living room
panels.visual: Abstract circular sound field and glowing fader tracks surrounding the sofa scene

panels.headline: The coach demonstrates one meter in front.
panels.visual: A person does squats on the living room carpet, AR full-body coach outline sketched in the foreground

panels.headline: The direction of the other party's gaze aligns with you
panels.visual: Multiple people FaceTime style rounded corner cards suspended in an arc-shaped wall, emphasizing eye contact of main view characters

style.art_style: Apple-style minimalist 3D rendering + matte metal and frosted glass + significant white space
style.typography: Chinese and Western unified use of sans-serif similar to SF, titles within 10 characters

must_keep: Four sections with white background/light gray and deep text contrast consistent, CTA pill button in the same position (bottom right or bottom center)
Each grid can stand independently, without relying on the other three grids for understanding
Each line of the title contains ≤ 12 characters.
avoid: Four sections use four unrelated illustration languages
More than one main CTA copy appears in a single cell
